regions.tonight: Dry this evening and for much of tonight. It will become increasingly cloudy overnight and easterly winds will strengthen ahead of rain arriving in the south of the province later in the night. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 9 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Sunday will be cloudy and blustery with outbreaks of rain in the south moving slowly northwards. The north of the province will stay largely dry all day. Highest temperatures of 7 to 10 degrees with fresh and gusty easterly winds, strong near coasts.
